```{r, general metadata}
file_metadata <- fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
rna_to_use <- file_metadata[
  assay_type == "RNA-Seq" &
    epirr_id_without_version %in%
      file_metadata[,
        if (.N >= 8) .SD,
        by = epirr_id_without_version
      ][, epirr_id_without_version],
  uuid
]

  epirr_id_without_version %in%
    file_metadata[, unique(epirr_id_without_version)]
]
```

```{r, load-events}
rmats_event_dir <- "splicing_analysis/rmats"
# Per-filter invocation (PLAN §4.12e per-filter incremental outputs): 03 now
# processes one transcript_filter per run and writes per-filter outputs
# (`*_{transcript_filter}` suffix). Snakemake passes TRANSCRIPT_FILTER;
# interactive runs fall back to the primary filter. All internal loops over
# `transcript_filters` therefore iterate a single element.
this_transcript_filter <- Sys.getenv(
  "TRANSCRIPT_FILTER",
  unset = getOption("EpiATLAS_AS_PRIMARY_FILTER", "biotype_filtered")
)
transcript_filters <- this_transcript_filter
id_col <- "event_id"

transcript_filter <- this_transcript_filter
event_type <- "SE"

event_res <- setNames(
  lapply(
    transcript_filters,
    function(transcript_filter) {
      # per-filter: one transcript_filter per job, so parallelise over the event
      # types (SE/RI) rather than the now length-1 filter axis (which left the
      # requested cores idle). outer stays lapply to avoid nested forking.
      setNames(
        pbmclapply(
          to_analyze, # as_events
          function(event_type) {
            print(sprintf(
              "Loading events for %s, %s",
              transcript_filter,
              event_type
            ))
            event_file <- file.path(
              rmats_event_dir,
              transcript_filter,
              paste0("event_", event_type, ".psi")
            )
            event_dt <- fread(event_file)
            setnames(event_dt, "V1", id_col)
            sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
            # drop all columns not in id_col or rnas_to_use, not all rnas are present in the event files (CREST data), so we need to intersect with the columns that are actually there
            event_dt <- event_dt[, c(id_col, sample_cols), with = FALSE]

            # prepare the alternative/upstream/downstream regions.
            # needs some data wrangling depending on the event type but basically we just parse the SUPPA event id
            # some information only needed for SE and RI and deleted for the other types
            if (event_type == "SE") {
              event_dt[,
                c(
                  "event_gene",
                  "seqnames",
                  "e1s2",
                  "e2s3",
                  "strand"
                ) := tstrsplit(
                  get(id_col),
                  ":",
                  fixed = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(
                  event_gene,
                  ";",
                  fixed = T
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("e1", "s2", "e2", "s3") := c(
                  tstrsplit(e1s2, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE),
                  tstrsplit(e2s3, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
                )
              ]
              all_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = e1, end = s3),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              upstream_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(
                    start = ifelse(strand == "+", e1, e2) + 1,
                    end = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s3) - 1
                  ),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              downstream_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(
                    start = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1) + 1,
                    end = ifelse(strand == "+", s3, s2) - 1
                  ),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              event_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = s2, end = e2),
                  strand = strand
                )]
            } else if (event_type == "RI") {
              event_dt[,
                c(
                  "event_gene",
                  "seqnames",
                  "s1",
                  "e1s2",
                  "e2",
                  "strand"
                ) := tstrsplit(
                  get(id_col),
                  ":",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(
                  event_gene,
                  ";",
                  fixed = T
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("e1", "s2") := tstrsplit(
                  e1s2,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              all_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = s1, end = e2),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              upstream_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(
                    start = ifelse(strand == "+", s1, s2),
                    end = ifelse(strand == "+", e1, e2)
                  ),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              downstream_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(
                    start = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s1),
                    end = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1)
                  ),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              event_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = e1 + 1, end = s2 - 1),
                  strand = strand
                )]
            } else if (event_type %in% c("AL", "AF")) {
              event_dt[,
                c(
                  "event_gene",
                  "seqnames",
                  "s1/e1s2",
                  "e1s3/e2",
                  "s2/e1s3",
                  "e2s3/e3",
                  "strand"
                ) := tstrsplit(
                  get(id_col),
                  ":",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(
                  event_gene,
                  ";",
                  fixed = T
                )
              ]
              event_dt[
                ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"),
                start_all := as.integer(`s1/e1s2`)
              ]
              event_dt[
                ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"),
                start_all := tstrsplit(
                  `s1/e1s2`,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )[[1]] +
                  1
              ]
              event_dt[
                ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"),
                end_all := as.integer(`e2s3/e3`)
              ]
              event_dt[
                ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"),
                end_all := tstrsplit(
                  `e2s3/e3`,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )[[2]] -
                  1
              ]
              all_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              upstream_gr <- NULL
              downstream_gr <- NULL
              event_gr <- NULL
            } else if (event_type %in% c("A3", "A5")) {
              event_dt[,
                c(
                  "event_gene",
                  "seqnames",
                  "e1s2/e2s3",
                  "e1s3",
                  "strand"
                ) := tstrsplit(
                  get(id_col),
                  ":",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(
                  event_gene,
                  ";",
                  fixed = T
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("e1/e2", "s2/s3") := tstrsplit(
                  `e1s2/e2s3`,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("e1", "s3") := tstrsplit(
                  e1s3,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              all_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = `e1/e2` + 1, end = s3 - 1),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              upstream_gr <- NULL
              downstream_gr <- NULL
              event_gr <- NULL
            } else if (event_type == "MX") {
              event_dt[,
                c(
                  "event_gene",
                  "seqnames",
                  "e1s2",
                  "e2s4",
                  "e1s3",
                  "e3s4",
                  "strand"
                ) := tstrsplit(
                  get(id_col),
                  ":",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(
                  event_gene,
                  ";",
                  fixed = T
                )
              ]
              event_dt[,
                start_all := tstrsplit(
                  e1s2,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )[[1]] +
                  1
              ]
              event_dt[,
                end_all := tstrsplit(
                  e3s4,
                  "-",
                  fixed = TRUE,
                  type.convert = TRUE
                )[[
                  2
                ]] -
                  1
              ]
              all_gr <-
                event_dt[, GRanges(
                  seqnames = seqnames,
                  ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
                  strand = strand
                )]
              upstream_gr <- NULL
              downstream_gr <- NULL
              event_gr <- NULL
            } else {
              stop("unknown event")
            }
            if (event_type %in% to_analyze) {
              # show event_dt without sample_cols
              hits <- findOverlaps(event_gr)

              from <- queryHits(hits)
              to <- subjectHits(hits)

              # keep <- from != to
              # from <- from[keep]
              # to <- to[keep]

              n <- length(event_gr)
              # Build an undirected graph, get components
              g <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(
                cbind(from, to),
                directed = FALSE
              )
              # Ensure isolated vertices are included
              stopifnot(igraph::vcount(g) == length(event_gr))
              # make sure that the graph has the same order as event_gr
              stopifnot(all(igraph::V(g) == unique(from)))
              # extract the components
              comp <- igraph::components(g)
              # add the cluster membership to the event_dt
              event_dt[, event_cluster := comp$membership]
              # get number of NAs per row in the sample columns
              event_dt[, n_na := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = sample_cols]

              # compute variability on raw PSI scale (matrixStats: C-level, ~100x faster than apply)
              psi_mat <- as.matrix(event_dt[, ..sample_cols])
              event_dt[, mad_psi := matrixStats::rowMads(psi_mat, na.rm = TRUE)]
              event_dt[, iqr_psi := matrixStats::rowIQRs(psi_mat, na.rm = TRUE)]
              event_dt[, sd_psi := matrixStats::rowSds(psi_mat, na.rm = TRUE)]
              rm(psi_mat)

              # representative = lowest NAs, then highest mad, then highest iqr
              event_dt[, .orig_order := .I]
              setorder(event_dt, event_cluster, n_na, -mad_psi, -iqr_psi)
              event_dt[,
                cluster_representative := !duplicated(
                  event_dt,
                  by = "event_cluster"
                )
              ]
              setorder(event_dt, .orig_order)
              event_dt[, .orig_order := NULL]
              # note whether on autoposomes or gonosomes
              event_dt[, is_autosome := !seqnames %in% c("chrX", "chrY")]
              event_dt[, transcript_filter := transcript_filter]
              return(list(
                event_dt = event_dt[,
                  c(
                    "event_id",
                    "gene_id",
                    "seqnames",
                    "strand",
                    "Event Type",
                    "transcript_filter",
                    "event_cluster",
                    "cluster_representative",
                    "n_na",
                    "mad_psi",
                    "iqr_psi",
                    "sd_psi",
                    "is_autosome",
                    ..sample_cols
                  )
                ],
                # dt with event info
                event_gr = event_gr,
                # gr of alternative region
                upstream_gr = upstream_gr,
                # gr of upstream region
                downstream_gr = downstream_gr,
                # gr of downstream region
                all_gr = all_gr # merged gr
              ))
            }
            list()
          },
          mc.cores = min(getOption("mc.cores", 1L), length(to_analyze))
        ),
        to_analyze
      )
    }
  ),
  transcript_filters
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, event-filtering}
# stack event_dts and gr objects for SE and RI events
event_dt <- data.table()
event_gr <- GRanges()
upstream_gr <- GRanges()
downstream_gr <- GRanges()
all_gr <- GRanges()
for (transcript_filter in transcript_filters) {
  for (this_event in to_analyze) {
    this_dt <- copy(event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_dt)
    this_event_gr <- event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_gr

    # actually append the data to GRanges
    event_gr <- c(event_gr, this_event_gr)
    upstream_gr <- c(
      upstream_gr,
      event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$upstream_gr
    )
    downstream_gr <- c(
      downstream_gr,
      event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$downstream_gr
    )
    all_gr <- c(all_gr, event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$all_gr)
    # actually append the data to data table
    event_dt <- rbind(event_dt, this_dt)
  }
}

rm(event_res)
# adjust ids to be unique indices
event_dt[, ID := seq.int(.N)]
event_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)] # make sure the order is correct
event_dt[,
  transcript_filter := factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters)
] # make sure the order is correct
# event_dt[, table(cluster_representative, is_autosome, transcript_filter, `Event Type`)]
event_dt[
  cluster_representative & is_autosome,
  table(transcript_filter, `Event Type`)
]
stopifnot(
  event_dt[,
    sum(cluster_representative) == 1L,
    by = .(transcript_filter, `Event Type`, event_cluster)
  ][, all(V1)]
)

# include experimental events manually, to make sure models are built for this:
#  4019, 4020, 460:463, 310:314, 8201:8202, 1658, 1048:1049, 13896:13897)

# double check ids
cols_to_factor <- c("event_id", "gene_id", "seqnames", "strand")
event_dt[, (cols_to_factor) := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = cols_to_factor]
sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
```

```{r, split-event-dt}
# Split wide event_dt → static annotations + long-format PSI (§ structural refactor)
event_annotations_dt <- event_dt[, !..sample_cols, with = FALSE]
psi_long_dt <- melt(
  event_dt[, c("ID", ..sample_cols), with = FALSE],
  id.vars = "ID",
  variable.name = "uuid",
  value.name = "psi",
  variable.factor = FALSE
)
rm(event_dt)
gc()
```

Splice-site sequence export, MaxEntScan scoring, and Pangolin scoring are run as
separate Snakefile rules (`maxentscan_scores`, `pangolin_scores`) after this notebook
completes. FASTA export happens after `keep_rows_manual` is defined below.


```{r, add-intrinsic-features}
# Load unfiltered annotation once; derive three filtered subsets in-memory.
# Saves 2 of 3 GTF file reads vs loading each filtered GTF separately.
unfiltered_annotation <- rtracklayer::import(
  "splicing_analysis/gencode.v29.annotation.gtf"
)

confidence_tsls <- c("1", "2")
polyA_biotypes <- c("protein_coding", "retained_intron")

tx_filter <- unfiltered_annotation$type == "transcript"
tsl_tx_filter <- tx_filter &
  unfiltered_annotation$transcript_support_level %in% confidence_tsls
biotype_tx_filter <- tsl_tx_filter &
  unfiltered_annotation$transcript_type %in% polyA_biotypes

filter_list <- list(
  transcripts = tx_filter,
  tsl_filtered = tsl_tx_filter,
  biotype_filtered = biotype_tx_filter
)

annotation_objects <- lapply(names(filter_list), function(tf_name) {
  this_filter <- filter_list[[tf_name]]
  unfiltered_annotation[
    (unfiltered_annotation$transcript_id %in%
      unfiltered_annotation[this_filter]$transcript_id) |
      (unfiltered_annotation$type == "gene" &
        unfiltered_annotation$gene_id %in%
          unfiltered_annotation[this_filter]$gene_id)
  ]
})
names(annotation_objects) <- names(filter_list)

# All three share the same source GTF seqlevels — adjust GRanges once here
seqlevels(event_gr) <- seqlevels(unfiltered_annotation)
seqlevels(upstream_gr) <- seqlevels(unfiltered_annotation)
seqlevels(downstream_gr) <- seqlevels(unfiltered_annotation)
seqlevels(all_gr) <- seqlevels(unfiltered_annotation)

rm(
  unfiltered_annotation,
  filter_list,
  tx_filter,
  tsl_tx_filter,
  biotype_tx_filter
)
gc()

annotations <- pbmclapply(
  transcript_filters,
  function(this_transcript_filter) {
    annotation <- annotation_objects[[this_transcript_filter]]
    exon_annotation <- annotation[annotation$type == "exon"]
    # seqlevels already adjusted in parent before forking

    # regions that need direct match:
    used_exons <- event_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]
    used_retained_introns <- all_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "RI",
      ID
    ]]
    used_regions <- c(used_exons, used_retained_introns)

    hits <- findOverlaps(exon_annotation, used_regions, type = "equal")
    #not enough? the neighboring regions should be in it as well, but are not kept anymore
    # these are not used currently, but should be later, we cannot treat transcript_ids with confidence atm
    used_upstream_introns <- upstream_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]
    used_downstream_introns <- downstream_gr[event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE",
      ID
    ]]

    is_negative_strand <- as.logical(strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) == "-")
    hit_upstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) + 1
    )
    hit_upstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) - 1,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1
    )
    hit_upstream_introns <- GRanges(
      seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = pmin(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends),
        end = pmax(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends)
      ),
      strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
    )
    hit_downstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) + 1,
      end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1
    )
    hit_downstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(
      is_negative_strand,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1,
      start(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) - 1
    )
    hit_downstream_introns <- GRanges(
      seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
      ranges = IRanges(
        start = pmin(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends),
        end = pmax(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends)
      ),
      strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
    )

    # now check direct matches for the introns, add retained introns again as decoy, such that lengths match
    upstream_match <- hit_upstream_introns ==
      c(used_upstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]
    downstream_match <- hit_downstream_introns ==
      c(used_downstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]

    # hits are only valid if it is RI, or or also have upstream and downstream match, otherwise we might have the wrong transcript,
    # because the exon matches but not the splice sites/introns
    valid_hits <- (upstream_match & downstream_match) | # splice site match
      to(hits) %in%
        seq(
          length(used_exons) + 1,
          length(used_exons) + length(used_retained_introns)
        ) # RI
    hit_dt <- unique(as.data.table(cbind(
      mcols(exon_annotation)[from(hits), c("gene_id", "transcript_id")],
      list(ID = to(hits))
    )))

    # for invalid_hits, remove the transcript_id, because we cannot be sure about the transcript, but keep the gene_id, because the exon match is correct and thus the gene should be correct
    hit_dt[!valid_hits, transcript_id := NA]
    # some not found, so this is not true anymore
    hit_dt[, stopifnot(uniqueN(ID) == length(used_regions))]

    used_transcripts <- annotation[
      annotation$type == "transcript" &
        (!is.na(annotation$transcript_id) &
          annotation$transcript_id %in% hit_dt[, transcript_id])
    ]
    used_tr_dt <- data.table(
      gene_id = used_transcripts$gene_id,
      transcript_id = used_transcripts$transcript_id,
      strand = as.factor(strand(used_transcripts)),
      tr_start = start(used_transcripts),
      tr_end = end(used_transcripts)
    )

    used_genes <- annotation[
      annotation$type == "gene" &
        (!is.na(annotation$gene_id) &
          annotation$gene_id %in% hit_dt[, gene_id])
    ]
    used_gene_dt <- data.table(
      gene_id = used_genes$gene_id,
      gene_start = start(used_genes),
      strand = as.factor(strand(used_genes)),
      gene_end = end(used_genes)
    )
    # start_end_anno <- merge(used_tr_dt, used_gene_dt)
    anno_hit_dt <- merge(hit_dt, used_gene_dt, by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
    anno_hit_dt <- merge(
      anno_hit_dt,
      used_tr_dt,
      by = c("gene_id", "transcript_id", "strand"),
      all.x = TRUE
    )
    anno_hit_dt
  },
  mc.cores = length(transcript_filters)
)
names(annotations) <- transcript_filters
annotation_dt <- rbindlist(annotations, idcol = "anno_transcript_filter")
# Fix the ids, because they are starting from 1 for each transcript filter, we just add the minimum minus 1 to the ids of each transcript filter
annotation_dt[,
  ID := ID +
    min(event_annotations_dt[
      transcript_filter == unique(anno_transcript_filter),
      ID
    ]) -
    1,
  by = anno_transcript_filter
]
setnames(annotation_dt, "anno_transcript_filter", "transcript_filter")
# aggregate the annotations by ID, gene_id and strand, taking a list for the transcript columns
agg_annotations <- annotation_dt[,
  .(
    tr_ids = list(na.omit(transcript_id)),
    tr_starts = list(na.omit(tr_start)),
    tr_ends = list(na.omit(tr_end))
  ),
  by = .(transcript_filter, ID, gene_id, strand, gene_start, gene_end)
]

merge_cols <- c("transcript_filter", "ID", "gene_id", "strand")
new_anno_cols <- setdiff(names(agg_annotations), merge_cols)
# event_annotations_dt[, (new_anno_cols) := NULL]
event_annotations_dt[
  agg_annotations,
  on = merge_cols,
  (new_anno_cols) := mget(new_anno_cols)
]

# rethink cluster_representative: shouldn't this be one with annotated transcript info?
# Vectorised: sort by group keys + priority criteria, mark first row per group with
# duplicated(by=) — fully C-level, no per-group R dispatch
event_annotations_dt[, .no_tr := lengths(tr_ids) == 0L]
event_annotations_dt[, .orig_order := .I]
setorder(
  event_annotations_dt,
  `Event Type`,
  transcript_filter,
  event_cluster,
  .no_tr,
  n_na,
  -mad_psi,
  -iqr_psi
)
event_annotations_dt[,
  cluster_representative_annotated := !duplicated(
    event_annotations_dt,
    by = c("Event Type", "transcript_filter", "event_cluster")
  )
]
setorder(event_annotations_dt, .orig_order)
event_annotations_dt[, c(".no_tr", ".orig_order") := NULL]
event_annotations_dt[
  cluster_representative_annotated == TRUE &
    lengths(tr_ids) == 0L
]
stopifnot(
  event_annotations_dt[,
    sum(cluster_representative_annotated) == 1L,
    by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, event_cluster)
  ][, all(V1)]
)


# get leftmost transcript start and rightmost transcript end for each event;
# distance formula handles strand direction, so min/max selection is strand-independent
event_annotations_dt[,
  closest_tr_start := vapply(
    tr_starts,
    function(x) if (length(x)) min(x) else NA_real_,
    numeric(1)
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  closest_tr_end := vapply(
    tr_ends,
    function(x) if (length(x)) max(x) else NA_real_,
    numeric(1)
  )
]

# add distance to TSS and TES
event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_TSS := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
    start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[!is.finite(distance_TSS), distance_TSS := NA]

event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_TES := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start,
    closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID])
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[!is.finite(distance_TES), distance_TES := NA]
identical(
  event_annotations_dt[is.na(distance_TSS), ID],
  event_annotations_dt[is.na(distance_TES), ID]
)

event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_gene_start := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    gene_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
    start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start
  )
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  distance_gene_end := fifelse(
    strand == "-",
    start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start,
    gene_end - end(event_gr[ID])
  )
]

# check that distance to TSS and TES are correlated with distance to gene start and end, respectively
ggplot(
  event_annotations_dt,
  aes(
    x = distance_gene_start + 1,
    y = distance_TSS + 1,
    color = is_autosome & cluster_representative
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~`Event Type`)

ggplot(
  event_annotations_dt,
  aes(
    x = distance_gene_end + 1,
    y = distance_TES + 1,
    color = is_autosome & cluster_representative
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  ggpubr::stat_cor(method = "spearman") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~`Event Type`)

# add region_lengths
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "upstream_other_region", sep = ";") := width(upstream_gr)
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "event_name", sep = ";") := width(event_gr)
]
event_annotations_dt[,
  paste("width", "downstream_other_region", sep = ";") := width(downstream_gr)
]
melt(
  event_annotations_dt[, .(
    `Event Type`,
    ID,
    is_autosome,
    cluster_representative,
    distance_TSS,
    distance_TES,
    distance_gene_start,
    distance_gene_end,
    `width;upstream_other_region`,
    `width;event_name`,
    `width;downstream_other_region`
  )],
  id.vars = c("Event Type", "ID", "is_autosome", "cluster_representative"),
  variable.name = "distance_type",
  value.name = "distance"
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = distance, color = is_autosome & cluster_representative)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(distance_type ~ `Event Type`, scales = "free")

# summary(event_annotations_dt[is_autosome & cluster_representative, .(distance_TSS, distance_TES, distance_gene_start, distance_gene_end, `width;upstream_other_region`, `width;event_name`, `width;downstream_other_region`)])
```

```{r, check event widths}
# since we want ~200 bp before and after the event, we can check the distribution of event widths to see how many events would have intersecting upstream and downstream regions
ggplot(
  event_annotations_dt,
  aes(x = width(event_gr), color = is_autosome & cluster_representative)
) +
  geom_density() +

make_window <- function(gr, window_size = 200, fix = "start", names = NULL) {
  window <- resize(gr, width = window_size, fix = fix)
  # if we are now outside the original gr, we need to adjust the window
  window <- pintersect(window, gr)
  stopifnot(all(window$hit))
  window$hit <- NULL
  window$name <- names
  return(window)
}

five_prime_up <- make_window(
  upstream_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "end",
  names = sprintf("5up_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
five_prime_down <- make_window(
  event_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "start",
  names = sprintf("5down_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
three_prime_up <- make_window(
  event_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "end",
  names = sprintf("3up_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
three_prime_down <- make_window(
  downstream_gr,
  window_size = 200,
  fix = "start",
  names = sprintf("3down_%d", event_annotations_dt[, ID])
)
```

```{bash, download-activeChromHMM}
set -euo pipefail
# GRCh38 genome FASTA for splice-site sequence extraction (read below + consumed
# by pangolin_scores rule 04-4). Static reference; download restored here after
# it was dropped in commit 9961b1d ("4 implemented"). -nc = no-clobber, so

# -P (dir prefix) not -O: wget rejects -nc together with -O. URL basename is
# already GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz, so it lands right.
wget -nc -q -P data/ \
https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/post_processed_data/Analysis/IHEC_gABC_Interactions/V2_StackedChromHMM_gABC/V2_StackedChromHMM_EnhancerStates_K27FC.bed.gz
```

```{r, assign-variability}
# Median split on sd_psi per event type × transcript_filter.
# sd_psi chosen over MAD/IQR: dip test confirms unimodal distribution (p≈1),
# no natural bimodal structure exists. Median split is the most defensible
# data-driven choice given the continuous spectrum. MAD rejected: ~27% SE and
# ~52% RI MAD=0 events have sd > 0.1 (bimodal misclassification).
event_annotations_dt[,
  Variability := fifelse(
    sd_psi > median(sd_psi, na.rm = TRUE),
    "High",
    "Low"
  ),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
event_annotations_dt[, table(
  Variability,
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated,
  transcript_filter,
  `Event Type`
)]

# define rows to keep
# !is.na(sd_psi) excludes events with <2 non-NA PSI samples post-02-3 masking
# (Variability is uncomputable for these) -- previously only filtered
# downstream in 05 as a stopgap; moved here so keep_rows_manual_{tf}.rds is no
# longer a superset of the modelled set. See 05-create-aggregated-dt.Rmd's
# now-redundant (but left in place as defense-in-depth) NA-Variability drop.
keep_rows_manual <- event_annotations_dt[
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated & !is.na(sd_psi),
  ID
]
# load ChromHMM states from https://ihec.sd4h.ca/IHEC/post_processed_data/Analysis/IHEC_gABC_Interactions/V2_StackedChromHMM_gABC/V2_StackedChromHMM_EnhancerStates_K27FC.bed.gz
activeChromHMM_dt <- data.table::fread(
  "data/V2_StackedChromHMM_EnhancerStates_K27FC.bed.gz",
  select = 1:3
)
#           #chr     start       end
#         <char>     <int>     <int>
#      1:   chr1      9800     10000
#      2:   chr1     28400     28800
#      3:   chr1     51800     52000
activeChromHMM <- GRanges(
  seqnames = activeChromHMM_dt[[1]],
  ranges = IRanges(start = activeChromHMM_dt[[2]], end = activeChromHMM_dt[[3]])
)
activeChromHMM$chrom_state <- activeChromHMM$name
# give them an name matching the index
activeChromHMM$name <-
  sprintf("chromhmm_%d", seq_along(activeChromHMM))
# find overlaps with the events
chromhmm_hits <-
  findOverlaps(
    event_gr[keep_rows_manual],
    activeChromHMM,
    maxgap = vicinity,
    ignore.strand = TRUE
  )
# Persist for 09-1-ml-local.R (per-event chromHMM-vicinity feature engineering,
# a separate local-modelling path from the pooled aggregated_dt/splicing_ml
# route). These 3 used to leave this session only via the now-removed
# aggregating.rda workspace dump; 09-1 has no other way to get them. Per-filter
# because 03 is per-filter (this_transcript_filter fixed for the whole run) —
# event_gr's row position == ID (event_dt[, ID := seq.int(.N)] above, 1-indexed,
# single filter per run) and chromhmm_hits' from() indexes into
# event_gr[keep_rows_manual] positions, so all three are internally consistent
# only when saved together from the SAME run (as here).
saveRDS(
  event_gr,
  sprintf("processed_data/event_gr_%s.rds", this_transcript_filter)
)
saveRDS(
  activeChromHMM,
  sprintf("processed_data/activeChromHMM_%s.rds", this_transcript_filter)
)
saveRDS(
  chromhmm_hits,
  sprintf("processed_data/chromhmm_hits_%s.rds", this_transcript_filter)
)
chromhmm_in_vicinity <-
  sort(unique(to(chromhmm_hits))) # [from(chromhmm_hits) %in% keep_rows_manual]))

# write the bed file over which averaging should be done:
aggregateOver <- c(
  # event_gr[keep_rows_manual],
  # upstream_gr[keep_rows_manual],
  # downstream_gr[keep_rows_manual],
  five_prime_up[keep_rows_manual],
  five_prime_down[keep_rows_manual],
  three_prime_up[keep_rows_manual],
  three_prime_down[keep_rows_manual],
  activeChromHMM[chromhmm_in_vicinity]
)
rtracklayer::export(
  aggregateOver,
  sprintf("processed_data/aggregateOver_%s.bed", this_transcript_filter)
)
```

```{r, sanity-helpers}
# Initialise qc/sanity_summary.csv and define append_sanity() helper.
# Placed here so variability-diagnostics and psi-distribution-sanity can both use it.
dir.create("qc/distributions", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
sanity_csv <- "qc/sanity_summary.csv"
if (!file.exists(sanity_csv)) {
  fwrite(
    data.table(
      check_name = character(),
      status = character(),
      value = numeric(),
      threshold = character(),
      notes = character()
    ),
    sanity_csv
  )
}
append_sanity <- function(check_name, status, value, threshold, notes = "") {
  new_row <- data.table(
    check_name = check_name,
    status = status,
    value = value,
    threshold = threshold,
    notes = notes
  )
  if (file.exists(sanity_csv)) {
    # upsert by check_name: drop any prior row for this check before writing
    # the new one, so sanity_summary.csv doesn't accumulate stale/duplicate
    # rows across reruns (append=TRUE never truncated -> the file only grew).
    existing <- fread(sanity_csv)
    existing <- existing[check_name != new_row$check_name]
    fwrite(rbind(existing, new_row, fill = TRUE), sanity_csv)
  } else {
    fwrite(new_row, sanity_csv)
  }
}
```

```{r, variability-diagnostics}
plot_dt <- event_annotations_dt[is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated]
plot_dt_long <- melt(
  plot_dt[, .(
    ID,
    `Event Type`,
    transcript_filter,
    Variability,
    mad_psi,
    iqr_psi,
    sd_psi
  )],
  id.vars = c("ID", "Event Type", "transcript_filter", "Variability"),
  variable.name = "measure",
  value.name = "value"
)

# histograms of sd/iqr/mad per Event Type x transcript_filter, colored by Variability
p_var_dist <- ggplot(plot_dt_long, aes(x = value, fill = Variability)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ transcript_filter + measure, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "PSI",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Variability measures (raw PSI scale) -- keep_rows events only"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)
print(p_var_dist)
ggsave(
  "qc/distributions/variability_distributions.pdf",
  plot = p_var_dist,
  width = 18,
  height = 6
)

# pairwise scatterplots of all three variability measures
pair_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(
  combn(c("mad_psi", "iqr_psi", "sd_psi"), 2, simplify = FALSE),
  function(p) {
    plot_dt[, .(
      pair = paste(p, collapse = " vs "),
      x = .SD[[p[1]]],
      y = .SD[[p[2]]],
      `Event Type`,
      transcript_filter,
      Variability
    )]
  }
))
p_var_scatter <- ggplot(pair_dt, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Variability)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ transcript_filter + pair, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Pairwise variability measures -- keep_rows events only"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)))
print(p_var_scatter)
ggsave(
  "qc/distributions/variability_scatter.pdf",
  plot = p_var_scatter,
  width = 20,
  height = 6
)

# MAD=0 but sd>0.1 check: diagnostic that motivated switching from MAD to sd.
# ~27% SE and ~52% RI MAD=0 events have sd > 0.1 — bimodal events where >50%
# of expressing samples sit at PSI=0/1. These are correctly captured by sd-based
# Variability. Kept as a sanity check to confirm the issue persists if MAD were used.
mad0_sd_check <- event_annotations_dt[
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated & mad_psi == 0 & sd_psi > 0.1,
  .N,
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
mad0_total <- event_annotations_dt[
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated & mad_psi == 0,
  .N,
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
mad0_check_dt <- mad0_sd_check[
  mad0_total,
  on = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
mad0_check_dt[, pct_discordant := N / i.N]
print(mad0_check_dt)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(mad0_check_dt))) {
  row <- mad0_check_dt[i]
  status <- if (row$pct_discordant <= 0.05) "PASS" else "WARN"
  if (status == "WARN") {
    warning(sprintf(
      "%.1f%% of MAD=0 %s %s events have sd_psi > 0.1 (potential bimodal misclassification)",
      100 * row$pct_discordant,
      row$`Event Type`,
      row$transcript_filter
    ))
  }
  append_sanity(
    paste0(
      "variability_mad0_sd_check__",
      row$`Event Type`,
      "__",
      row$transcript_filter
    ),
    status,
    row$pct_discordant,
    "<= 0.05",
    sprintf(
      "%s %s: %.1f%% MAD=0 events have sd>0.1",
      row$`Event Type`,
      row$transcript_filter,
      100 * row$pct_discordant
    )
  )
}

append_sanity(
  "variability_diagnostics_pdf",
  "PASS",
  NA_real_,
  "visual",
  "qc/distributions/variability_distributions.pdf"
)

# Hartigan dip test for unimodality on each variability measure.
# H0 = unimodal; p < 0.05 = multimodal structure exists.
# If all p >> 0.05: no natural structure → any High/Low split is arbitrary.
library(diptest)
dip_results <- rbindlist(lapply(
  c("mad_psi", "iqr_psi", "sd_psi"),
  function(measure) {
    rbindlist(lapply(to_analyze, function(et) {
      rbindlist(lapply(
        levels(event_annotations_dt$transcript_filter),
        function(tf) {
          vals <- event_annotations_dt[
            `Event Type` == et &
              transcript_filter == tf &
              is_autosome &
              cluster_representative_annotated,
            get(measure)
          ]
          vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
          d <- dip.test(vals)
          data.table(
            measure = measure,
            event_type = et,
            transcript_filter = tf,
            n = length(vals),
            dip_stat = unname(d$statistic),
            p_value = d$p.value
          )
        }
      ))
    }))
  }
))
print(dip_results)
fwrite(dip_results, "qc/variability_dip_test.csv")
```

```{bash, download-genome}
  https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/archive/old_genbank/Eukaryotes/vertebrates_mammals/Homo_sapiens/GRCh38/seqs_for_alignment_pipelines/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz
```

```{r, export-splice-site-sequences}
# Export splice-site FASTA sequences for MaxEntScan and Pangolin scoring.
# Only keep_rows_manual events — subset defined above.
# MaxEntScan Perl scripts and Pangolin Python script run as Snakefile rules.
library(Biostrings)
genome_fasta <- "data/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz"
genome <- readDNAStringSet(genome_fasta)
names(genome) <- tstrsplit(names(genome), "[ \t]+", keep = 1)[[1]]

# Restrict GRanges to keep_rows_manual rows
keep_idx <- event_annotations_dt[, ID %in% keep_rows_manual]
keep_dt <- event_annotations_dt[keep_idx]
is_se <- keep_dt[, `Event Type` == "SE"]

upstream_gr_k <- upstream_gr[keep_idx]
downstream_gr_k <- downstream_gr[keep_idx]
event_gr_k <- event_gr[keep_idx]

# 5' splice-site sequences (9-mer: 3 exon + 6 intron)
# Donor = end of exon on the pre-mRNA. Use strand-flipped promoters() to anchor at range end.
event_gr_k_flip <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(event_gr_k),
  ranges = ranges(event_gr_k),
  strand = ifelse(strand(event_gr_k) == "+", "-", "+")
)
# RI: 5'ss = start of intron (event_gr_k = retained intron)
event5ss <- promoters(event_gr_k, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)

# SE: 5'ss of skipped exon (exon2 donor) = end of event_gr_k
se5ss_ranges <- promoters(event_gr_k_flip, upstream = 6, downstream = 3)[is_se]
# SE: 5'ss of upstream exon (E1 donor): upstream_gr_k = upstream intron, so flank at its
# outer boundary gives [e1,e1] for "+" and [s3,s3] for "-" — i.e. the exon/intron junction.
e1_junc_gr <- flank(upstream_gr_k[is_se], 1L, start = TRUE)
e1_junc_flip <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(e1_junc_gr),
  ranges = ranges(e1_junc_gr),
  strand = ifelse(strand(e1_junc_gr) == "+", "-", "+")
)
upe5ss_ranges <- promoters(e1_junc_flip, upstream = 6, downstream = 3)
ri5ss_ranges <- event5ss[!is_se]
ss5_idx <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss5_gr <- c(se5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_idx]
ss5up_gr <- c(upe5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_idx]

ss5 <- genome[ss5_gr]
ss5up <- genome[ss5up_gr]
ss5[keep_dt[, strand == "-"]] <- reverseComplement(ss5[keep_dt[,
  strand == "-"
]])
ss5up[keep_dt[, strand == "-"]] <- reverseComplement(ss5up[keep_dt[,
  strand == "-"
]])
names(ss5) <- keep_dt[, ID]
names(ss5up) <- keep_dt[, ID]
ss5 <- ss5[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5), function(x) length(x) == 0)]
ss5up <- ss5up[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5up), function(x) length(x) == 0)]

# 3' splice-site sequences (23-mer: 20 intron + 3 exon)
# Acceptor = start of exon on the pre-mRNA (promoters() default anchors at start).
up3ss <- promoters(event_gr_k, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
# SE: 3'ss of skipped exon (E2 acceptor) = start of event_gr_k
se3ss_ranges <- up3ss[is_se]
# SE: 3'ss of downstream exon (E3 acceptor): downstream_gr_k = downstream intron, so flank
# at its outer boundary gives [s3,s3] for "+" and [e1,e1] for "-" — the intron/exon junction.
e3_junc_gr <- flank(downstream_gr_k[is_se], 1L, start = FALSE)
downe3ss_ranges <- promoters(e3_junc_gr, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
# RI: 3'ss = start of downstream exon (downstream_gr_k = downstream exon for RI)
ri3ss_ranges <- promoters(
  downstream_gr_k[!is_se],
  upstream = 20,
  downstream = 3
)
ss3_idx <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss3_gr <- c(se3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_idx]
ss3_down <- c(downe3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_idx]

ss3 <- genome[ss3_gr]
ss3down <- genome[ss3_down]
ss3[keep_dt[, strand == "-"]] <- reverseComplement(ss3[keep_dt[,
  strand == "-"
]])
ss3down[keep_dt[, strand == "-"]] <- reverseComplement(ss3down[keep_dt[,
  strand == "-"
]])
names(ss3) <- keep_dt[, ID]
names(ss3down) <- keep_dt[, ID]
ss3 <- ss3[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3), function(x) length(x) == 0)]
ss3down <- ss3down[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3down), function(x) {
  length(x) == 0
})]

# Write FASTAs (per-filter: feed the per-filter maxentscan/pangolin rules)
tf <- this_transcript_filter
ss5_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss_%s.fasta", tf)
ss5up_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss_up_%s.fasta", tf)
ss3_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss_%s.fasta", tf)
ss3down_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss_down_%s.fasta", tf)
writeXStringSet(ss5, filepath = ss5_file)
writeXStringSet(ss5up, filepath = ss5up_file)
writeXStringSet(ss3, filepath = ss3_file)
writeXStringSet(ss3down, filepath = ss3down_file)

# --- splice-site coordinate sanity: canonical dinucleotides -----------------
# Guards the splice-site extraction/strand logic (cf. the SE splice-site
# coordinate bug fixed 2026-06-29). MaxEntScan layout: 5'ss 9-mer = 3 exon + 6
# intron -> donor GT at positions 4-5; 3'ss 23-mer = 20 intron + 3 exon ->
# acceptor AG at positions 19-20. Sequences are already reverse-complemented
# for '-' strand, so the canonical orientation holds. ~1-2% non-canonical
# (GC-AG / AT-AC) splice sites are biologically real, so WARN below 95% but
# hard-stop only below 90% (a gross coordinate/strand bug).
.canon_frac <- function(seqs, pos, motif) {
  if (length(seqs) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  mean(substr(as.character(seqs), pos, pos + 1L) == motif, na.rm = TRUE)
}
ss_canon <- data.table(
  fasta = c("5ss", "5ss_up", "3ss", "3ss_down"),
  motif = c("GT", "GT", "AG", "AG"),
  frac = c(
    .canon_frac(ss5, 4L, "GT"),
    .canon_frac(ss5up, 4L, "GT"),
    .canon_frac(ss3, 19L, "AG"),
    .canon_frac(ss3down, 19L, "AG")
  )
)
print(ss_canon)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(ss_canon))) {
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("splice_site_canonical_%s__%s", ss_canon$fasta[i], tf),
    if (!is.na(ss_canon$frac[i]) && ss_canon$frac[i] >= 0.95) {
      "PASS"
    } else {
      "WARN"
    },
    ss_canon$frac[i],
    0.95,
    sprintf(
      "fraction with canonical %s dinucleotide (splice-site coord/strand sanity)",
      ss_canon$motif[i]
    )
  )
}
stopifnot(all(ss_canon$frac[!is.na(ss_canon$frac)] >= 0.90))

# Score file paths (written per-filter by the maxentscan_scores Snakefile rule)
ss3_score_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3scores_%s.txt", tf)
ss3down_score_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3down_scores_%s.txt", tf)
ss5_score_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5scores_%s.txt", tf)
ss5up_score_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5up_scores_%s.txt", tf)

rm(genome)
gc()
```

```{r, load-ijc-sjc}
# Load IJC/SJC written by 02z (§4.8/§4.12f)
# JC files at splicing_analysis/rmats/<transcript_filter>/event_<type>.jc.csv.gz
# suppa_id matches event_annotations_dt$event_id; join → ID; save for 05-create-aggregated-dt
id_map <- event_annotations_dt[, .(
  ID,
  event_id,
  transcript_filter = as.character(transcript_filter)
)]
jc_list <- rbindlist(lapply(transcript_filters, function(tf) {
  rbindlist(lapply(to_analyze, function(et) {
    jc_file <- file.path(
      "splicing_analysis/rmats",
      tf,
      paste0("event_", et, ".jc.csv.gz")
    )
    if (!file.exists(jc_file)) {
      warning(sprintf("JC file missing: %s", jc_file))
      return(NULL)
    }
    dt <- fread(jc_file)
    dt[, transcript_filter := tf]
    dt
  }))
}))
jc_list[id_map, on = .(suppa_id = event_id, transcript_filter), ID := i.ID]
stopifnot(nrow(jc_list[is.na(ID)]) == 0L)
stopifnot(nrow(jc_list[is.na(IJC) | is.na(SJC)]) == 0L)
ijc_sjc_dt <- jc_list[, .(ID, uuid, IJC, SJC)]
fwrite(
  ijc_sjc_dt,
  sprintf("processed_data/ijc_sjc_dt_%s.csv.gz", this_transcript_filter)
)
```

```{r, psi-distribution-sanity}
# §4.13a: PSI distribution sanity checks

# Build working table: long PSI + protocol + Event Type (all events, all transcript_filters)
uuid_protocol <- file_metadata[
  assay_type == "RNA-Seq",
  .(uuid, protocol = experiment_type)
]
psi_check_dt <- psi_long_dt[
  event_annotations_dt[, .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)],
  on = "ID",
  nomatch = NULL
][
  uuid_protocol,
  on = "uuid",
  nomatch = NULL
]

# 1. All PSI in [0, 1] — all events, all transcript_filters (data integrity)
psi_ok <- all(psi_check_dt[!is.na(psi), psi >= 0 & psi <= 1])
stopifnot(psi_ok)
append_sanity(
  "psi_range__all_events",
  if (psi_ok) "PASS" else "FAIL",
  as.numeric(psi_ok),
  "[0,1]",
  "all events, all transcript_filters"
)

# Restrict to keep_rows_manual (fixed analysis set) for all remaining checks
psi_check_km_dt <- psi_check_dt[ID %in% keep_rows_manual]

# 2. Per-event mean PSI histograms — keep_rows_manual, all transcript_filters (visual)
mean_psi_dt <- psi_check_km_dt[
  !is.na(psi),
  .(mean_psi = mean(psi)),
  by = .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter, protocol)
]
p_psi_dist <- ggplot(mean_psi_dt, aes(x = mean_psi)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ transcript_filter + protocol, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Per-event mean PSI", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()
print(p_psi_dist)
ggsave(
  "qc/distributions/psi_distributions.pdf",
  plot = p_psi_dist,
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)
append_sanity(
  "psi_distributions_pdf",
  "PASS",
  NA_real_,
  "visual",
  "keep_rows_manual; qc/distributions/psi_distributions.pdf"
)

# 3 & 4: SE bimodality + variable fraction — keep_rows_manual, per transcript_filter
transcript_filters <- unique(mean_psi_dt[["transcript_filter"]])
for (tf in transcript_filters) {
  se_mean_psi_tf <- mean_psi_dt[
    `Event Type` == "SE" & transcript_filter == tf,
    mean_psi
  ]

  # 3. SE bimodality: dip test on per-event mean PSI
  if (requireNamespace("diptest", quietly = TRUE)) {
    dip_result <- diptest::dip.test(se_mean_psi_tf)
    cat(sprintf(
      "[%s] SE bimodality (dip test): D=%.4f, p=%.4g\n",
      tf,
      dip_result$statistic,
      dip_result$p.value
    ))
    dip_status <- if (dip_result$p.value < 0.05) "PASS" else "WARN"
    if (dip_status == "WARN") {
      warning(sprintf(
        "[%s] SE PSI dip test non-significant — expected bimodality not confirmed",
        tf
      ))
    }
    append_sanity(
      paste0("se_bimodality_dip_p__", tf),
      dip_status,
      dip_result$p.value,
      "< 0.05",
      "keep_rows_manual"
    )
  } else {
    warning("diptest package not available; skipping SE bimodality check")
    append_sanity(
      paste0("se_bimodality_dip_p__", tf),
      "SKIP",
      NA_real_,
      "< 0.05",
      "diptest not installed"
    )
  }

  # 4. SE variable fraction: ≥ 20% events with mean PSI in (0.05, 0.95)
  pct_variable <- mean(se_mean_psi_tf > 0.05 & se_mean_psi_tf < 0.95)
  cat(sprintf("[%s] SE variable fraction: %.1f%%\n", tf, 100 * pct_variable))
  stopifnot(pct_variable >= 0.20)
  if (pct_variable < 0.30 || pct_variable > 0.50) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "[%s] SE variable fraction %.1f%% outside expected 30-50%% range",
      tf,
      100 * pct_variable
    ))
  }
  append_sanity(
    paste0("se_variable_fraction__", tf),
    if (pct_variable >= 0.20) "PASS" else "FAIL",
    pct_variable,
    ">= 0.20",
    if (pct_variable < 0.30 || pct_variable > 0.50) {
      "outside 30-50% expected range; keep_rows_manual"
    } else {
      "keep_rows_manual"
    }
  )
}

# 5. RI protocol median: total-RNA-Seq > mRNA-Seq + 0.02 — keep_rows_manual, per transcript_filter
for (tf in transcript_filters) {
  ri_medians <- psi_check_km_dt[
    `Event Type` == "RI" & transcript_filter == tf & !is.na(psi),
    .(med = median(psi)),
    by = protocol
  ]
  cat(sprintf("RI PSI medians by protocol [%s]:\n", tf))
  print(ri_medians)
  if (all(c("mRNA-Seq", "total-RNA-Seq") %in% ri_medians[, protocol])) {
    ri_diff <- ri_medians[protocol == "total-RNA-Seq", med] -
      ri_medians[protocol == "mRNA-Seq", med]
    stopifnot(ri_diff > 0.02)
    append_sanity(
      paste0("ri_protocol_median_diff__", tf),
      if (ri_diff > 0.02) "PASS" else "FAIL",
      ri_diff,
      "> 0.02",
      "total-RNA-Seq minus mRNA-Seq RI PSI median; keep_rows_manual"
    )
  } else {
    append_sanity(
      paste0("ri_protocol_median_diff__", tf),
      "SKIP",
      NA_real_,
      "> 0.02",
      "missing protocol(s)"
    )
  }
}

# Note: item 6 (PSI sd vs gene_expression quantile) deferred to 05 §4.13d
# (gene_expression not available until aggregation step)
```

```{r, variability-balance-sanity}
# §4.13h: assert and plot Variability balance per Event Type x transcript_filter
var_balance <- event_annotations_dt[
  is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated,
  .(
    n_high = sum(Variability == "High", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_low = sum(Variability == "Low", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_high = mean(Variability == "High", na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]
print(var_balance)

# assertions: median split always yields ~50% High per stratum; allow 40-60% tolerance
for (tf in levels(event_annotations_dt$transcript_filter)) {
  for (et in to_analyze) {
    pct <- var_balance[`Event Type` == et & transcript_filter == tf, pct_high]
    if (!length(pct) || is.na(pct)) {
      next
    }
    status <- if (pct >= 0.40 & pct <= 0.60) "PASS" else "WARN"
    if (status == "WARN") {
      warning(sprintf(
        "%s High variability %.1f%% outside 40-60%% range (%s) -- median split should give ~50%%",
        et,
        100 * pct,
        tf
      ))
    }
    append_sanity(
      paste0("variability_balance_", tolower(et), "__", tf),
      status,
      pct,
      "0.40-0.60",
      sprintf("%s pct_high=%.3f", et, pct)
    )
  }
}

p_var_balance <- ggplot(
  var_balance,
  aes(x = transcript_filter, y = pct_high, fill = `Event Type`)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% High variability",
    title = "Variability balance -- keep_rows events (is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
print(p_var_balance)
ggsave(
  "qc/distributions/variability_balance.pdf",
  plot = p_var_balance,
  width = 8,
  height = 4
)
append_sanity(
  "variability_balance_pdf",
  "PASS",
  NA_real_,
  "visual",
  "qc/distributions/variability_balance.pdf"
)
```

```{r, junction-coverage-sanity}
# §4.13i: junction read coverage (IJC + SJC) for keep_rows events
jc_check_dt <- ijc_sjc_dt[
  ID %in% keep_rows_manual
][
  event_annotations_dt[, .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)],
  on = "ID",
  nomatch = NULL
]
jc_check_dt[, total_jc := IJC + SJC]

# per-event median across expressing samples (total_jc > 0; zeros = unexpressed = expected for tissue-specific events)
jc_event_median <- jc_check_dt[
  total_jc > 0,
  .(med_jc = median(total_jc)),
  by = .(ID, `Event Type`, transcript_filter)
]

p_jc_cov <- ggplot(jc_event_median, aes(x = log10(med_jc + 1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log10(10 + 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_grid(`Event Type` ~ transcript_filter, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "log10(median IJC + SJC + 1)",
    y = "Events",
    title = "Junction read coverage -- keep_rows events (conditional on expressing samples)",
    subtitle = "Red dashed = 10 reads; zeros excluded (unexpressed samples)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11)
print(p_jc_cov)
ggsave(
  "qc/distributions/junction_coverage.pdf",
  plot = p_jc_cov,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)

for (tf in levels(event_annotations_dt$transcript_filter)) {
  for (et in to_analyze) {
    med_vals <- jc_event_median[
      `Event Type` == et & transcript_filter == tf,
      med_jc
    ]
    if (!length(med_vals)) {
      next
    }
    pct_low <- mean(med_vals < 10)
    status <- if (pct_low <= 0.10) "PASS" else "WARN"
    if (status == "WARN") {
      warning(sprintf(
        "%.1f%% %s %s events have median junction coverage < 10",
        100 * pct_low,
        et,
        tf
      ))
    }
    append_sanity(
      paste0("junction_coverage_pct_low__", et, "__", tf),
      status,
      pct_low,
      "<= 0.10",
      sprintf("%s %s: %.1f%% events below 10 reads", et, tf, 100 * pct_low)
    )
  }
}
```

```{r, cross-table-consistency}
# Cross-table referential integrity before writing: every PSI / junction /
# keep_rows event ID must be annotated in event_annotations_dt, and event
# counts per Event Type are logged so a rerun's event set is comparable.
ann_ids <- event_annotations_dt[, unique(ID)]
stopifnot(
  all(psi_long_dt[, unique(ID)] %in% ann_ids),
  all(ijc_sjc_dt[, unique(ID)] %in% ann_ids),
  all(keep_rows_manual %in% ann_ids)
)
append_sanity(
  sprintf("event_id_referential_integrity__%s", this_transcript_filter),
  "PASS",
  1,
  1,
  "psi_long / ijc_sjc / keep_rows event IDs all present in event_annotations"
)
# Event counts per Event Type (all annotated events, and the modelled subset)
ann_counts <- event_annotations_dt[, .(n = uniqueN(ID)), by = `Event Type`]
km_counts <- event_annotations_dt[
  ID %in% keep_rows_manual,
  .(n = uniqueN(ID)),
  by = `Event Type`
]
print(ann_counts)
print(km_counts)
for (et in ann_counts[["Event Type"]]) {
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("n_events_annotated_%s__%s", et, this_transcript_filter),
    "INFO",
    ann_counts[`Event Type` == et, n],
    NA_real_,
    "count of annotated events (before keep_rows_manual)"
  )
  append_sanity(
    sprintf("n_events_keep_rows_%s__%s", et, this_transcript_filter),
    "INFO",
    km_counts[`Event Type` == et, if (.N) n else 0L],
    NA_real_,
    "count of modelled events (autosomal + cluster_representative)"
  )
}
```

```{r, save-workspace}
# Per-filter outputs (PLAN §4.12e per-filter incremental). sample_cols is the
# sample (uuid) axis — near filter-invariant, but the present-sample set can
# differ slightly by filter (different event files), and a wildcard Snakemake
# rule cannot safely share one non-wildcard output across parallel per-filter
# jobs — so it is written per-filter too.
fwrite(
  event_annotations_dt,
  sprintf(
    "processed_data/event_annotations_dt_%s.csv.gz",
    this_transcript_filter
  )
)
fwrite(
  psi_long_dt,
  sprintf("processed_data/psi_long_dt_%s.csv.gz", this_transcript_filter)
)
# ijc_sjc_dt already written (per-filter) by load-ijc-sjc chunk
# aggregateOver_{tf}.bed already written by assign-variability chunk
# to_analyze    → defined in .Rprofile, no save needed
# file_metadata → unmodified in 03; downstream scripts fread("processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")
saveRDS(
  sample_cols,
  sprintf("processed_data/sample_cols_%s.rds", this_transcript_filter)
)
saveRDS(
  keep_rows_manual,
  sprintf("processed_data/keep_rows_manual_%s.rds", this_transcript_filter)
)
```
